_comment: Hooks for working on Aphelion. The Stop hook runs the fast Python checks
rather than the Godot suite: the reference sim covers the physics in
seconds with no dependencies, while a headless Godot run needs GUT fetched
and takes long enough to be annoying on every stop. Run the full suite
before opening a pull request — CONTRIBUTING.md has the command.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.gd) command -v gdformat >/dev/null 2>&1 && gdformat "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; python3 tools/refsim/validate_physics.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'Aphelion: tools/refsim/validate_physics.py is failing — the physics changed and the numerical checks no longer pass.'; python3 tools/refsim/author_missions.py 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q '^15/15' || echo 'Aphelion: not all fifteen reference solutions still fly. Run tools/refsim/author_missions.py.'; exit 0
